description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_FontFamily`, which validates font-family CSS attribute values according to CSS specifications. It includes methods for constructing validation rules and for validating font-family strings, handling generic font names, quoted font names, and unquoted font names with special characters.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_FontFamily
classes.description: A class responsible for validating CSS font-family attribute values, ensuring they conform to the CSS specification and handling various font naming conventions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class by setting up a character mask that includes lowercase and uppercase letters, digits, and UTF-8 special bytes, used for validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a font-family string according to CSS rules, including handling generic font names, quoted font names, and font names with special characters. Returns a sanitized string of font names or false if invalid.
